We must be very careful with factors of 2. To obtain the potential energy for the interaction of NA positive ions with NA negative ions, it is necessary to multiply the total potential energy of a given ion due to all others by 2NA and then divide by 2 to avoid counting the interaction of a given pair of ions twice. This gives the preceding result.
